fate.display: 10 May 1945; died at Mauthausen after liberation, following Nazi imprisonment.

fateClassificationNote: Death as a result of Nazi persecution; specific circumstances are described without inferring a direct execution.
biography: Peter van Pels went into hiding in Amsterdam with his parents and the Frank family.
uncertainty: The Anne Frank House cites a medical-staff list for 10 May. His death after liberation must not be described as a direct execution.
